disposition.note: ftp://ftp.azsos.gov/cfsdata2/ — Arizona's own bulk campaign-finance drop: THIS PROCESS HOLDS NO FTP CLIENT. The drop was walked 2026-08-26 and is anonymous, live, and carries 8,828 Arizona campaign committees and the state's 109 filing jurisdictions. That is RULING 166's rung ZERO and it outranks every page-by-page route below it. The missing piece is an adapter in this repository, which is a fact about OUR tooling and is never a fact about the record — REQUIRES_NEW_ADAPTER, and the obligation stays live. NEXT MOVE: an FTP client. Until one exists this route disposes REQUIRES_NEW_ADAPTER on a clock rather than being forgotten, which is the difference between a named next move and an absence.
